sources.title: ICRS Cartilage Injury Evaluation Package
sources.access: Web text retrieved; diagram screenshot requested but no model-readable image received. Do not claim visual interpretation.
sources.summary: The society document identifies ICRS classes and explicitly distinguishes below-half depth from above-half depth in its second and third classes. Grade4 is presented as a separate advanced class.

sources.title: ICRS Recommendations for Clinical Studies in Knee Articular Cartilage Repair
sources.access: Indexed table text retrieved by web search; direct open returned a challenge page.
sources.summary: The society recommendations define named ICRS grade4 as penetration into subchondral bone. This supports a deep/full-depth interpretation of a source report that explicitly names ICRS4; it does not identify an unnamed numeric grading system.

sources.title: Interpretation of Cartilage Damage at Routine Clinical MRI: How to Match Arthroscopic Findings
sources.location: MRI Interpretation and Morphologic Changes sections
sources.summary: The article describes depth categories separating below-half, above-half and complete cartilage damage, and distinguishes depth from extent. It also explains limitations of MRI depth assessment and why a focal severe lesion should not automatically be called generalized severe OA.

scope: Named ICRS interpretation is primary-source supported. Direct high-grade partial-thickness and low-grade thinning interpretations below are disclosed report-level morphology inferences, not proof that every center uses a universal numeric grade or that MRI images were reread. No rubric, source, or gold labels changed.
